source.description:
PROBLEM: The collapsed fleet line ends in "↓/← inspect", promising that Down/Left opens the fleet. Operator-verified live 2026-09-08: pressing Down/Left does nothing; only the collapsed line itself renders. Cause, verified in source: keyboard handling exists ONLY inside the ui.custom inspector (index.mjs keybindings.register fleet-down/up/attach/back + tui.onKey fallback) -- nothing intercepts keys in the idle editor state, and pi 0.85.1 offers passive extensions no global key API (KeybindingsManager reaches extension code only inside custom()/setEditorComponent factories, per pi dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts:117-166). The inspector opens solely via the /fleet inspect command. pi-subagents -- the copied model -- likewise opens its navigator via slash command (/subagents:sessions), never via arrow keys; the arrow premise was never true there either.

SUCCESS: The collapsed line advertises only triggers that work: name /fleet inspect (and /fleet:reply when asks wait) instead of ↓/←. In-inspector keys (j/k, enter, esc) stay as-is. No dead key promises anywhere in the fleet surface (collapsed, expanded, inspector help line).

SCOPE: Specialists repo fleet render strings only (collapsed line, expanded help line, inspector help line in index.mjs) + unit-test expectation updates. No API, placement, or behavior changes.

NON_GOALS: Global arrow-key interception (unimplementable on this pi API -- do not attempt editor-component replacement for a hint); live-TUI proof beyond the operator re-check.

CONSTRAINTS: Keep lines within existing width/overflow budgets. Suite green, tsc clean. No dist rebuild needed (no src changes; mjs ships as-is) -- verify this holds.

VALIDATION: Unit tests assert the collapsed line contains /fleet inspect and no ↓/← activation promise; operator re-check in live TUI (the original reporter) confirms the hint matches reality.

OUTPUT: Commit on a specialists branch, operator confirmation recorded in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes: SCOPE AMENDMENT 2026-09-08 (operator directive): drop the arrows (↓/←) from the collapsed line entirely -- the inspector they gestured at is deferred, so no arrow promise of any kind. Collapsed hint must name the text-report path (/fleet shows the report; /fleet:reply answers asks). Row wording (spent->bare tokens) moved to unitAI-d99hb which owns renderFleetRowLine.
source.title: Collapsed fleet hint promises arrow-key activation that cannot exist
